fields.summary: TC-668-03: LCO Code D When Pilot Demoted From Flying to Deadhead on Original Flight (OR-07)

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-668

Precondition: A pilot was originally scheduled to operate a flight (Flying leg, isOriginal=true) and is involuntarily reassigned to deadhead that same original flight. Rule OR-07 applies (Original Deadhead Demote Rule). Out of Scope: LRO, RRO, Guarantees, Special Rules.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up trip V0 where the pilot is the operating crew member on a flying leg (isOriginal=true, legType=Flying)
V0: HOU->DAL, legType=Flying, isOriginal=true, position=FO
Trip V0 exists with pilot as operator on HOU->DAL
Trigger an involuntary Save and Replace (V1) that changes the pilot from Flying to Deadhead on the same original flight number, origin, and destination
Same flight HOU->DAL, legType changed from Flying to Deadhead, changeType=INVOL, V1
Trip V1 created with pilot now assigned as Deadhead on the original HOU->DAL flight
Trigger the LCO Lambda on V1 of the trip
Involuntary deadhead demotion scenario: originally flying, now deadheading the same original flight
Lambda is invoked successfully without errors
Verify the LCO lambda applies deadhead-demotion override code D per rule OR-07
Original flight (isOriginal=true) now as Deadhead in V1, changeType=INVOL
lcoCode = D (deadhead demotion on original flight - no LCO pay)
Confirm the DB update lambda persists lcoCode = D for the demoted leg in DynamoDB
Lambda output payload with lcoCode=D on the deadhead demotion leg
DynamoDB record shows lcoCode = D on the deadhead demotion leg
